messages:
maria: FYI MercuryHealth is reporting p99 spikes on embeddings for their Dedicated pool. CS escalated ~06:30 PT. They see 5-10x latencies. Need eng-platform + infra ownership and a short mitigation plan.
aj: Oncall - looking. Can someone paste the query samples and current pod counts? I'll check autoscaler activity.
leo: I pulled controller logs — we saw OOMs from the model server around 06:27-06:32. Autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough. Looks tied to the v2-quant rollout. Assigning eng-infra to investigate.
sahil: I'll take infra. Quick mitigation: can we route MercuryHealth to the fallback model variant (v1 non-quant) for 30-60m? That should cut token latency.
maria: CS says they want an SLA-safe workaround now. Who owns routing policy changes?
jess: I can own routing. Plan: manual route override for mercury-org -> model:v1-256q for 45m, then re-evaluate. Need infra confirmation on capacity before flipping.
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2024-0671 and paged eng-infra.
sahil: infra can accept traffic. I'll prep the fallback pool and bump replicas. Command I'll run: ```kubectl -n inference scale deploy/serve-v1 --replicas=6 && ./rtctl update-route --org mercuryhealth --model v1-256q```
jess: Applying route change now, will post status. ETA ~5m.
jess: Done — route updated. CS reports p99 dropped from ~3.2s -> ~420ms. Monitoring dashboards show request rate stable. :thumbsup:
maria: Great. Next: eng-platform to own an automated fallback policy, eng-ml to triage v2-quant regression. Need owners and timelines.
leo: Owners: eng-platform (jess + leo) to draft auto-fallback runbook and implement a safe default policy; target: QA rollout today, prod gating tomorrow EOD. eng-ml (samantha) to triage v2-quant regressions and propose patch/rollback plan by tomorrow EOD.
samantha: Ack — I'll pull modelserver logs and reproduce with the quantized weights locally. Preliminary hypothesis: KV-cache misalignment when sequence lengths vary causing extra compute/oom. Will report findings in ~4-6h.
maria: CS requests an incident note & short customer-facing timeline. Jess — can you post an incident summary + playbook links and ping sales/solutions so MercuryHealth PM gets a follow-up?
jess: On it. Draft timeline I'll post to #incidents and attach logs + the manual-change PR: 06:28 spike begins, 06:33 incident raised, 06:40 fallback applied, 06:45 p99 normalized. Will link PR for auto-fallback and infra PR for min-replicas bump.
sahil: Infra will add a controller OOM alert and a small autoscaler tweak (bump min-replicas for dedicated pools with heavy KV usage). I'll open the PR by 14:00 PT.
maria: Thanks all. If anyone needs me to coordinate CS/customer comms, ping me directly.
aj: Closing loop for now — marked mitigated. Keep monitoring and paste any regression metrics here.
